constraints: Use counts as delivered: no pre-scaling or pre-normalization of the count table
steps.description: Load /eval-four-models-v2-with-no-replicates-1v1-s1-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12,000 genes x 2 samples) and metadata/metadata.csv (2 samples, condition: treatment, 1 treated vs 1 control). Import raw integer counts into a DESeq2 dataset with condition as factor. Run blind variance-stabilizing transformation, plot PCA on the 500 most variable genes, heatmap of Euclidean sample distances, and per-sample library size / distribution summaries. With only two samples the plots are descriptive sanity checks, not batch or outlier inference.
acceptance_criteria: Counts matrix parses with 12,000 gene rows and 2 sample columns matching the metadata sample IDs exactly
Library sizes and count distributions reported per sample
Blind vst, PCA (top 500 variable genes) and sample-distance heatmap produced
No inferential claim about condition differences made anywhere in the QC output

steps.name: Descriptive log2 fold changes, treated vs control (no inferential test)
caveats: If any group holds one sample, do no inferential differential expression test. Without within-group replication no dispersion can be estimated, and a p-value from such a design has no inferential basis. Report normalized counts and descriptive log2 fold changes, state that the design has no replication, and name the design that supports inference.

Counts are salmon-derived and the profile does not state whether the length correction was applied; note in the output that gene-level fold changes may be mildly biased for genes with length differences between conditions
steps.question: Which genes show the largest expression differences between the treated sample and the control sample, as descriptive log2 fold changes on median-of-ratios-normalized counts?
steps.description: Pre-filter genes to >=10 counts in at least the smallest group size (1 sample). Estimate median-of-ratios size factors. Set condition factor levels explicitly with control as reference and compute the treated-vs-control log2 fold change per gene from a DESeq2-style fit used only to obtain size factors and normalization, then rank genes by |log2FC|. Output a full ranked table (gene, baseMean normalized counts per sample, log2FC) plus a short summary (n tested, n with |log2FC| >= 1, top genes). NO p-values, NO adjusted p-values, NO 'significant' labels: with 1 vs 1 there is no dispersion estimate, so all inferential DE methods are forbidden. Every output and the table header must state 'descriptive, unreplicated design'.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-filter applied: genes with <10 counts in the minimum group-size samples removed; n tested reported
Size factors are median-of-ratios, estimated by DESeq2 on raw counts (no pre-normalized input)
Contrast stated as (condition, treated, control) with control set explicitly as reference level; positive log2FC means higher in treated
Output table contains gene ID, normalized counts per sample, and log2FC, with no p-value or padj column
All outputs labelled descriptive-only for the 1-treated-vs-1-control unreplicated design

steps.name: Reproducibility report and interpretive limits
steps.question: What does this analysis establish about gene expression differences between treated and control, and under what design could it support inference?
constraints: report: report_fields = method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, session_info (doi:10.1093/bib/bbz124)
report: reproducibility_record = session_info, seed, package_versions, collection_version, annotation_release (doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1003285)
steps.description: Summarize the analysis: method and package versions (DESeq2 1.52.0), design (1 treated vs 1 control, no biological replication), thresholds (pre-filter min_count=10, |log2FC| ranking cutoff), n tested after filter, top ranked genes with their log2FC, and full sessionInfo. State plainly that because the design has no within-group replication no dispersion could be estimated and no p-value is inferentially meaningful, so the gene list is a ranked descriptive hypothesis list only; name the design that would support inference (>=3 biological replicates per condition, modeled with DESeq2 Wald test). Include the reproducibility record (sessionInfo, package versions, seed) stored with the results.
acceptance_criteria: Report names method, package versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, and top genes by log2FC
Report states explicitly that no inferential DE statement is possible at 1 vs 1 and names the replicated design that would support one
Reproducibility record (sessionInfo, package versions, seed) attached to the results

plan.title: Treated vs control liver: descriptive DE, no replication
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 12,000-gene x 2-sample human liver count matrix (salmon-derived counts as delivered) with one treated and one control sample and no biological replication. With one sample per condition no dispersion can be estimated, so no inferential differential expression test (DESeq2 Wald/LRT, edgeR QL, limma-voom p-values) is valid; the knowledge procedure flags this design (R-0003@6b3a) with outcome descriptive_only and forbids all inferential DE methods (M-0001..M-0005, M-0017). The plan therefore (1) runs sample-structure QC with blind variance-stabilizing transformation, (2) applies the pre-filter and median-of-ratios size factors, computes descriptive log2 fold changes for treated vs control, and ranks genes by |log2FC| with normalized counts attached — reporting the effect size as a descriptive quantity, never as a p-value-tested result — and (3) produces a reproducibility report stating explicitly that the design has no replication, that no inferential statement is possible, and naming the replicated design (e.g. >=3 biological replicates per condition) that would support inference. Fold changes are computed from counts as delivered; because the profile does not state whether salmon's length correction was applied, the report will note that fold changes for genes with transcript-length differences between conditions may be mildly biased, which does not change the no-inference conclusion.

steps.method: DESeq2 blind vst sample structure QC
DESeq2 size-factor normalization with descriptive log2 fold changes, no inferential test
Reproducibility report with method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_de, session_info
